items.zh: 第一次办银行卡要带什么材料？
items.scene: 刚入职，午休抽空去银行网点办工资卡

answers.en: What do I need to bring to open a bank account?
answers.note: 最中性的问法，直接问要带什么，柜台和电话里都能用。

answers.en: What paperwork do I need for a new account?
answers.note: paperwork 强调书面材料，适合已经决定开户、只想确认清单时问。

answers.en: Do I need anything besides my ID to open an account?
answers.note: 默认身份证就够了，再确认还有没有别的，像排队时随口补问。

items.zh: 今天办卡能当场拿到卡吗？
items.scene: 在银行柜台办卡，下午还要赶回公司

answers.en: Can I get the card today?
answers.note: 最短最直接，柜员一听就懂，赶时间时用，不绕弯子。

answers.en: Will the card be ready right away, or does it come in the mail?
answers.note: 把当场拿和邮寄两种可能摆出来，适合不确定制卡方式时问。

answers.en: Is there any way to walk out with the card today?
answers.note: any way 带点请求和着急，walk out with 指当场带走，强调今天必须用。

items.zh: 这张卡收年费吗？
items.scene: 办卡前，你指着宣传单问大堂经理

answers.en: Does this card have an annual fee?
answers.note: 标准问法，只问有没有，不带情绪，办卡前先确认。

answers.en: Am I going to get hit with an annual fee on this card?
answers.note: get hit with 是口语，暗担心被悄悄收费，适合对推销不太放心时。

answers.en: Is the annual fee waived the first year?
answers.note: 已经默认有年费，直接问首年免不免，显得懂行，适合比较几张卡。

items.zh: 跨行转账一般多久能到？
items.scene: 给外地房东转房租，你问银行客服

answers.en: How long does a transfer to another bank usually take?
answers.note: 中性问时长，usually 表明问一般情况，适合第一次跨行转账。

answers.en: How fast will the money land in the other account?
answers.note: land 指钱到账，口语感强，关心对方什么时候能收到。

answers.en: Is it same-day or does it take a few business days?
answers.note: 二选一逼出具体时间，business days 指工作日，适合赶截止日期。

items.zh: 钱转错账户了，还能追回来吗？
items.scene: 转账填错卡号，正打银行客服电话

answers.en: I sent money to the wrong account. Can it be reversed?
answers.note: reversed 是银行术语，指撤回，语气冷静，适合正式说明情况。

answers.en: I transferred money to the wrong person by mistake. Is there any way to get it back?
answers.note: 先认错再求助，any way 带恳求，适合钱已经到对方账上。

answers.en: Can you cancel that transfer? The account number was wrong.
answers.note: 直接要求取消，假定还来得及，适合刚点完确认就发现错了。

items.zh: 能不能现在就转过去，对方急着用？
items.scene: 家人住院要交押金，你在柜台催柜员

answers.en: Can you send it right now? They need it urgently.
answers.note: 直接催，right now 和 urgently 把急迫说透，适合当面求柜员加急。

answers.en: Is there a way to make it go through instantly?
answers.note: 问有没有即时到账的办法，go through 指转账成功，语气稍缓。

answers.en: I need this transferred immediately — is that possible?
answers.note: 先摆需求再问可行性，immediately 很强硬，适合医院等不能拖的场合。

items.zh: 转五万要收多少手续费？
items.scene: 在手机银行准备转五万，问在线客服

answers.en: How much does it cost to transfer fifty thousand?
answers.note: 最常用的问价方式，cost 比 fee 更口语，柜台和客服都能问。

answers.en: What's the charge on a transfer that size?
answers.note: charge 更口语，that size 指这个金额，适合已经说过金额后追问。

answers.en: Is there a fee if I transfer fifty thousand?
answers.note: 是非问句，暗含希望免费，适合先试探再决定转不转。

items.zh: 有没有免手续费的办法？
items.scene: 每月给父母打生活费，你问柜员怎么省手续费

answers.en: Is there a way to avoid the fee?
answers.note: 中性求助，avoid 只问能不能绕开，不显得计较。

answers.en: Can I get around the transfer fee somehow?
answers.note: get around 指绕开收费，语气轻松，适合打听有没有别的路子。

answers.en: Do you waive the fee if I transfer through the app?
answers.note: waive 是免除，直接问某个条件，适合已经知道有优惠活动。

items.zh: 今天美元汇率多少？
items.scene: 准备去美国旅游，在银行问美元汇率

answers.en: What's the exchange rate for the dollar today?
answers.note: 最普通的问法，问当天牌价，柜台和电话都能用。

answers.en: How's the dollar looking today?
answers.note: 最随口的问法，looking 指行情怎么样，适合跟柜员或熟人闲聊。

answers.en: What's your rate on dollars today?
answers.note: your rate 指这家银行实际给的价，适合比价时逐家问。

items.zh: 手机银行换汇和去柜台换，哪个更划算？
items.scene: 孩子在国外读书，要换一笔学费，你比较手机银行和柜台

answers.en: Is it cheaper to exchange money in the app or in person?
answers.note: 直接比价格，cheaper 最直白，in person 指跑一趟网点。

answers.en: Which gives me a better rate — the app or the branch?
answers.note: 问哪边汇率更好，rate 更专业，适合换的金额较大。

answers.en: Should I just do the exchange on my phone instead of coming in?
answers.note: 征求建议，just 和 instead of coming in 带偷懒意味，适合嫌跑网点麻烦。

items.zh: ATM 能存现金吗？
items.scene: 晚上拿着一沓现金，在街边找 ATM

answers.en: Does this ATM take cash deposits?
answers.note: 标准问法，take cash deposits 指能不能存现金，先确认机器功能。

answers.en: Can I deposit cash in this machine?
answers.note: 最直白，一句就能问清，适合晚上赶时间、不想多解释。

answers.en: Is this ATM accepting deposits right now?
answers.note: 加 right now 问当下是否可用，适合机器贴着暂停服务时。

items.zh: 三年定期的利率是多少？
items.scene: 攒了几年，手里有笔闲钱，坐在柜台前咨询

answers.en: What's the interest rate on a three-year CD?
answers.note: CD 是美国最常用的定期存款说法；在国内网点说 time deposit 也能懂。

answers.en: How much interest would I get if I lock up the money for three years?
answers.note: lock up 指把钱锁三年，解释性强，适合第一次存定期。

answers.en: What rate are you paying on three-year deposits?
answers.note: paying 是银行常用说法，语气像老客户，适合直接问收益。

items.zh: 定期还没到期，能提前取出来吗？
items.scene: 老家房子漏水要修，家里临时急用钱

answers.en: Can I take the money out before the CD matures?
answers.note: matures 指到期，用词准确，适合正式询问规则。

answers.en: What happens if I need to withdraw early?
answers.note: 不问能不能，先问后果，适合担心急用钱的人。

answers.en: Is there a penalty for cashing out early?
answers.note: penalty 指提前支取的罚金，cashing out 偏口语，适合已经打算提前取。

items.zh: 这个理财会亏本吗？
items.scene: 银行经理推荐产品，你有点犹豫

answers.en: Can I lose money on this product?
answers.note: 最直接的问法，lose money 谁都听得懂，适合当面追问经理。

answers.en: Is my principal guaranteed?
answers.note: principal 指本金，guaranteed 指保本，问得专业，适合当面确认风险。

answers.en: What are the chances I actually lose money here?
answers.note: chances 问可能性，actually 带怀疑，适合对推销话术不放心。

items.zh: 这个理财一年大概能赚多少？
items.scene: 对比几款产品，你问客户经理

answers.en: About how much would this earn in a year?
answers.note: about 让回答不必精确，earn 指赚多少，适合粗略了解。

answers.en: What kind of return are we talking about here?
answers.note: return 指回报，are we talking about 是口语追问，适合私下打听收益。

answers.en: What's the expected annual yield on this?
answers.note: yield 是收益率术语，expected 指预期，适合认真做投资比较。

items.zh: 有没有保本的产品？
items.scene: 退休的父母想稳妥理财，让你陪着问

answers.en: Do you have anything that's principal-protected?
answers.note: principal-protected 是保本的专业说法，适合明确要保本产品。

answers.en: Is there anything that's guaranteed not to lose money?
answers.note: 用大白话问保本，guaranteed not to lose money 直白好懂，适合长辈开口。

answers.en: I'd rather play it safe — what do you have?
answers.note: play it safe 表明偏好稳妥，先表态再问，适合不想被推销高风险产品。

items.zh: 现在房贷利率是多少？
items.scene: 准备买房，你咨询贷款经理

answers.en: What's the current mortgage rate?
answers.note: 标准问法，mortgage 指房贷，适合快速了解行情。

answers.en: What rate are you offering on home loans these days?
answers.note: these days 指最近，offering 是银行常用说法，适合闲聊式打听。

answers.en: Where are mortgage rates sitting right now?
answers.note: rates sitting 是新闻里常见的说法，像在讨论行情，适合比较多家银行。

items.zh: 房贷能提前还一部分吗？
items.scene: 年终奖到账，你打电话问贷款银行

answers.en: Can I pay down part of my mortgage early?
answers.note: pay down 指还掉一部分本金，用词准确，适合正式咨询。

answers.en: Is there a penalty if I pay off some of the loan ahead of schedule?
answers.note: ahead of schedule 指提前，先问罚金，适合金额较大时。

answers.en: Could I put a chunk of money toward the loan early?
answers.note: a chunk of money 指一笔钱，口语生动，适合商量还款安排。

items.zh: 贷款审批要多久？
items.scene: 着急用钱，你在信贷窗口问审批进度

answers.en: How long does approval take?
answers.note: 最短问法，approval 指审批，适合已经递交材料后追问。

answers.en: How soon would the loan go through?
answers.note: go through 指贷款批下来，朋友之间也这么说，关心多久能拿到钱。

answers.en: What's the turnaround time on a loan like this?
answers.note: turnaround time 是办结时限的商务说法，适合正式场合问进度。

items.zh: 银行卡密码忘了怎么办？
items.scene: 在 ATM 前连输错三次密码，卡被吞了

answers.en: What do I do if I forgot my PIN?
answers.note: PIN 是银行卡密码的准确说法，问流程，柜台和电话都能用。

answers.en: I blanked on my PIN — how do I reset it?
answers.note: blanked on 指一时想不起来，很口语，适合跟柜员随口说。

answers.en: Can I reset my PIN at the counter?
answers.note: 直接问能不能在柜台重置，适合已经到网点、不想再跑一趟。

items.zh: 密码能自己在手机上改吗？
items.scene: 收到一条异地登录提醒，你想马上改密码

answers.en: Can I change my card PIN in the app?
answers.note: 问能不能在手机银行改，in the app 明确渠道，适合先自己试。

answers.en: Is there a way to reset my PIN from my phone?
answers.note: from my phone 强调不用去网点，is there a way 语气客气。

answers.en: Do I have to come into the branch to change it, or can I do it online?
answers.note: 把跑网点和线上两种方式摆出来，适合确认最省事的办法。

items.zh: 卡丢了，现在挂失来得及吗？
items.scene: 刚发现钱包不见，你打电话给银行

answers.en: I lost my card. Can I report it lost right now?
answers.note: report it lost 是挂失的固定说法，语气镇定，适合先说明情况。

answers.en: My card's gone — can you freeze it immediately?
answers.note: freeze 指冻结，immediately 很急，适合刚发现被偷。

answers.en: I need to report my card missing. Is it too late to block it?
answers.note: block 指停卡，too late 流露担心，适合不确定有没有被盗刷。

items.zh: 补一张卡要多久？
items.scene: 卡挂失后，你问多久能用上新卡

answers.en: How long does it take to get a replacement card?
answers.note: replacement card 指补办的新卡，标准问法，适合问大概时间。

answers.en: When can I get a new card?
answers.note: 最短最直接，只问什么时候能拿到，适合赶着用卡。

answers.en: Will the new card be mailed, or can I pick it up here?
answers.note: 问邮寄还是自取，pick it up 指来网点拿，适合安排时间。

items.zh: 信用卡额度能提吗？
items.scene: 双十一想换台新手机，信用卡额度不够

answers.en: Can I get my credit limit increased?
answers.note: 标准问法，被动语态显得客气，适合打电话给客服。

answers.en: Any chance you could bump up my limit?
answers.note: bump up 指提高，Any chance 很口语，适合跟熟悉的客户经理开口。

answers.en: How do I raise my credit limit?
answers.note: 问具体操作步骤，raise 中性，适合自己在 app 里找入口。

items.zh: 临时额度到期了还没还上，会怎么样？
items.scene: 刷了临时额度，你担心还款出问题

answers.en: What happens if the temporary increase expires before I pay off my balance?
answers.note: 把临时额度和未还余额说清，问后果，适合打电话给客服。

answers.en: What if I don't pay it off before the temporary increase runs out?
answers.note: runs out 指额度到期，比 expires 更口语，适合口头确认。

answers.en: Will I get charged extra if the temp limit expires before I pay it back?
answers.note: get charged extra 问会不会多收钱，temp limit 很口语，适合算成本。
